End on her.\n\nShot sizes alternate on purpose: wide → macro → three-quarter → high angle → medium close-up. Keep it that way if scenes are added.\n\nRENDERING\n• Keep SUBJECT identical in C-03, C-04, C-05 so her face stays the same. Change expression and hair in POSE or at the end of SUBJECT only.\n• C-01: if a figure appears on the path, add \"no people\" to ABSOLUTE again or lower the CFG.\n• C-02: the seal and the handwriting decide the shot — render more, pick the sharpest letters.\n• C-03: the lamp is the only warm light. Reject renders where the room turns warm overall.\n• C-04: the spiral must read as one shape. If the steps break into a mess, try a 35mm lens or a slightly lower angle.\n• C-05: turn \"looking at viewer\" on. Wind in the hair helps; a stiff pose does not.\n\nLOOK\nCold blue sea, pale gold light, one warm source per night scene. VISUAL SUITE - SAMPLE WORKFLOW
Studio Leiel · comfyui-visual-suite

A series of pictures, not one picture at a time.
Write every scene of a series in the Series Book, queue them with recipes in the Series Lab, pick the keepers in the Image Viewer, see what worked in the Series Report, and lay the series out in the Series Layout - as print spreads, web frames and a short film.

────────────────────────
1. MODELS (Krea 2 Turbo)
────────────────────────
Download from huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2 and place them here:

ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/
    krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors
ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/
    qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors
ComfyUI/models/vae/
    qwen_image_vae.safetensors

If a loader shows a red frame, the file is missing or named differently - pick yours from its list.

────────────────────────
2. THE NODES
────────────────────────
SERIES BOOK - the whole series in one node: scenes, anchors (quality, subject, outfit, pose, scene, camera, absolute), notes and frames. A sample series, "The Keeper's Letter", is already in it.

SERIES LAB - the queue. Scenes and LoRAs go on shelves, combine into recipes, and render one after another. Keep adding and removing while it runs.

FILENAME MANAGER - names and folders every render by date, series, scene and recipe, so the output sorts itself.

LATENT SIZE PICKER - the size of each render; random within a list, or one fixed size.

IMAGE VIEWER - follows the renders as they are saved. Pick the keepers, delete the rest.

SERIES REPORT - what the series has made so far: picks, prompt versions, tone, framing, recipes, render time, and the history of every series.

SERIES LAYOUT - the series laid out from the Book's words and the Viewer's picks. PRINT: magazine spreads to PDF, a print package and an InDesign (IDML) file. WEB: frames for posts, in four sizes. MOTION: a short film of the picks with title, captions, music, markers and a timeline, saved as MP4 - and a post text to go with it.

NODE BAG - keeps the model and sampler nodes folded away. Double-click to open.

────────────────────────
3. FIRST RENDER
────────────────────────
1. Check the three models above.
2. In the Series Lab, click a scene of "The Keeper's Letter" on the Prompt Shelf, press + ADD TO QUEUE, drag the recipe into the orange QUEUE BOX and press RUN ALL.
3. Watch the Image Viewer fill. Pick the ones you like, delete the ones you don't.
4. Open the Series Report: with LIVE on, every render is counted as it is saved.
5. Open the Series Layout: every cut with a pick is laid out. Choose PRINT, WEB or MOTION, click a pick in CUTS to add or take it out, then EXPORT.

Your own series: Series Book > + SERIES, then write the scenes, or paste a whole series pack with PASTE ALL.
